title: potamogeton filiformis f. alpinus
intro: Potamogeton filiformis f. alpinus, commonly known as Alpine Water Clover, is a type of aquatic plant that belongs to the family Potamogetonaceae. This plant has been found to have several health benefits, including its potential to lower blood sugar levels and reduce inflammation. Its therapeutic actions include antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Alpine Water Clover include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
